scenes.name: ONE SIGN / 同一个符号
lines: Can an integral and a divisibility test always give the same sign?
一个积分与一个整除检测，能否总给出相同符号？
Start with n equal to four. Integrating this degree-five polynomial gives one sixth, whose reduced numerator is plus one.
先取 n 等于四。这个五次多项式的积分为六分之一，最简分子为正一。
Among one through four, exactly two fourth powers are divisible by four. Two sign flips also give plus one.
一到四中，恰好两个数的四次方能被四整除。翻转两次，仍是正一。

scenes.name: THE SWITCH / 整除开关
lines: The floor of a number rounds it down. Compare t divided by n with t minus one, divided by n.
向下取整得到不超过原数的最大整数。比较 t 除以 n，与 t 减一之后再除以 n。
The floors differ by one exactly when n divides t. Otherwise they agree.
恰好在 n 整除 t 时，两个取整相差一；否则相同。
So one minus twice their difference is a switch: minus one for success, plus one otherwise.
因此，一减去两倍取整差就是开关：成功为负一，否则为正一。

scenes.name: COUNT MULTIPLES / 数倍数
lines: For the original exponent n, success means that k contains every prime dividing n.
对原来的指数 n，成功意味着 k 含有 n 的每个质因子。
Their product is the radical. For twelve, the radical is six, and the successful integers are six and twelve.
这些不同质因子的乘积叫根基。十二的根基是六，成功者为六和十二。
There are n divided by the radical successes. Only the parity of that count matters to the product.
成功者共有 n 除以根基个。乘积只关心这个数量的奇偶性。

scenes.name: FOUR STEPS / 四步周期
lines: Why does integration agree? These polynomials turn the cosine of an angle into the cosine of a multiple angle.
积分为何相同？这些多项式把一个角的余弦变成倍角的余弦。
Substitution reduces the integral to endpoint cosines, cycling through one, zero, minus one, zero.
代入后，积分只需计算端点余弦，依次循环为一、零、负一、零。
The resulting fractions have numerator plus or minus one. At degree n plus one, the numerator is positive exactly when four divides n.
所得分数的分子为正一或负一。在次数 n 加一时，分子为正恰好等价于四整除 n。

scenes.name: COUNTS AND PARITY / 数量与奇偶
lines: Changing the exponent can change the count without changing the sign.
改变指数会改变成功者数量，却未必改变符号。
For sixteen, squares require multiples of four: four successes. Fourth powers require even integers: eight successes.
对十六，平方要求四的倍数，有四个成功者；四次方只要求偶数，有八个成功者。
Both counts are even. Every exponent at least two gives the same sign. For n greater than one, the count reaches its radical value at the largest prime exponent.
两种计数都是偶数。任何至少为二的指数都给出相同符号。对大于一的 n，计数在指数达到最大的质数指数时达到根基公式的数值。

scenes.name: SHIFT AND CONNECT / 平移与相认
lines: Shift to any sixteen consecutive integers. The multiples of four still occur four times, even across zero.
平移到任意十六个连续整数，四的倍数仍出现四次，即使跨过零。
Browne proposed the original identity; an earlier Lean proof establishes both equalities shown here. Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang explain the mechanism and prove the extensions in writing.
Browne 提出原始恒等式；较早的 Lean 证明建立了这里显示的两个等式。Haobo Ma 与 Wenlin Zhang 解释其机制，并给出推广的书面证明。
The boundary matters: exponent one always gives minus one. Count first, then ask whether the count is even.
边界条件很重要：指数为一时，乘积总是负一。先计数，再问它是否为偶数。
